answer: Every identity is a vertex that must post a small bond to transact. The ledger links vertices whose bonds came from the same funding source into one cluster. If any vertex is proven fake, the whole cluster is slashed, not just the culprit. An honest agent risks one small bond, violet on the public graph. A sybil farmer must lock fresh capital behind every puppet, and since the cluster shares one fate, one detection burns the whole farm. Hopping like a comet between identities does not dilute the cost: the funding trail persists, so each fake multiplies the capital one slash can burn.
